STANDARD FEATURES
Power and Handling Driver Controls
3.7-liter Ti-VCT aluminum V6 engine Auto Hold
303 hp @ 6,500 rpm 278 lb.-ft. of torque @ 4,000 rpm Compass display
EPA-estimated fuel economy ratings1 Dual-zone electronic automatic temperature control
Standard FWD 17 city/25 hwy/20 combined mpg Intelligent Access with push-button start
Optional AWD 16 city/23 hwy/19 combined mpg
Leather-wrapped steering wheel
6-speed SelectShift® automatic transmission with paddle activation
Push-button shift transmission
Electric parking brake
Remote Start System
Electric Power-Assisted Steering (EPAS)
Steering wheel-mounted controls for cruise and audio
Front-wheel drive (FWD)
Power disc brakes with Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) Audio Systems
Torque Vectoring Control Lincoln Sound System with 10 speakers including a subwoofer
Traction control SiriusXM® Satellite Radio with 6-month trial subscription
Driver-Assist Technology S eating
Autolamp 10-way power front seats with 2-way power lumbar and driver’s side memory feature
Hill start assist 60/40 split-fold-flat rear seat with EasyFold® seat back release
Reverse Sensing System
SYNC® 3 with 8" color LCD capacitive touchscreen in center stack with swiping capability, 911 Assist,® Safety and Security
AppLink,® Apple CarPlay™ Support, Android Auto™, and 2 smart-charging USB ports Personal Safety System™ for driver and front passenger with dual-stage front airbags,2 safety belt
pretensioners, safety belt energy-management retractors, safety belt usage sensors, driver’s seat
Exterior position sensor, crash severity sensor, restraint control module and Front-Passenger Sensing System
Dual bright exhaust tips Driver’s knee airbag2
Easy Fuel® capless fuel filler Front-seat side airbags2
HID headlamps with LED signature lighting Glove-box-door-integrated knee airbag2
LED signature taillamps Side-curtain airbags2 with roll-fold technology
Power, heated, body-color sideview mirrors with LED turn signal indicators, memory AdvanceTrac® with RSC® (Roll Stability Control™)
and integrated blind spot mirrors LATCH (Lower Anchors and Tether Anchors for Children)
MyKey®
Lincoln Experiences Perimeter alarm
LED-illuminated exterior door handles Rear view camera
Lincoln Approach Detection System SecuriCode™ invisible keypad
Lincoln logo welcome mat SecuriLock® Passive Anti-Theft System
Lincoln signature fade-on/-off exterior lighting SOS Post-Crash Alert System™
Lincoln Way App™ Tire Pressure Monitoring System (excludes spare)
